Rae (Docs): Heads-up: Product wants the changelog live before tomorrow's deploy. Need a tight customer blurb, migration snippet, and one short known-issue + rollback sentence. Can we finalize in this thread?
Priya (PM): Keep the customer line simple: 'Embeddings endpoint consolidated to /api/embeddings — update payload to use model_id by 2026-05-10.' Make sure the date is explicit.
Ken (SDK): I'll update code samples. Quick note: Node/Python need payload key change model -> model_id. Go also needs import path change. I'll paste exact diffs.
Marta (QA): I'll run snippet tests once diffs are in. Also will smoke-test staging for 400s after deploy.
Ken (SDK): Node diff (old -> new):
old: fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?model=embed-x', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ input }) })
new: fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/api/embeddings', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ model_id: 'embed-2026-small', input }) })
Python diff: client.embeddings(input='hi', model='embed-x') -> client.embeddings(input='hi', model_id='embed-2026-small')
Go diff: payload field -> model_id and import path github.com/redwood/sdk -> github.com/redwood/inference-go/sdk
Rae (Docs): Thanks Ken. I'll swap the code blocks and add a short "compatibility shim" example for legacy clients.
i18n-bot: Reminder: provide source strings for translators in key/value form to avoid missing translations.
Rae (Docs): Source strings: changelog.embeds.announce = "Embeddings endpoint consolidated; migrate to /api/embeddings using model_id by 2026-05-10." changelog.embeds.known_issue = "Legacy clients sending 'model' may receive 400s; update payloads or use the migration shim."
Priya (PM): Approved. For rollback: if >5% error rate after migration, contact support to enable temporary aliasing for 48h while clients are fixed. Keep that one sentence.
Ken (SDK): Migration shim idea for curl: curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/api/embeddings' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Allow-Legacy-Model: true' -d '{"model_id":"embed-2026-small","input":"hello"}'
Marta (QA): I'll run snippet-tests and linkcheck after Ken's PR. If we see redirects to /v1/embeddings, I will raise a quick fix.
docs-ci: linkcheck found two references to /v1/embeddings in docs/snippets/cli/quickstart.md :warning:
Rae (Docs): On it — I'll replace those and push. Also adding a tiny "If you see issues" paragraph pointing to /ops/runbooks/changelog-rollback and support contact.
Ken (SDK): Opened PR 4387 with Node/Python/Go snippet updates and the shim example.
docs-ci: CI started for branch release/embeds-consolidation (checks: lint, linkcheck, snippet-tests)
Marta (QA): Snippet-tests queued. Will report back in ~20m.
docs-ci: build passed on branch release/embeds-consolidation (linkcheck fixed, snippet-tests pending) :white_check_mark:
Marta (QA): Snippet-tests passed for Node/Python; Go snippet failed due to old import path lingering in one example. Ken, can you update the last Go file?
Ken (SDK): Pushed fix for Go import. Re-running tests.
docs-ci: snippet-tests passed. All checks green.
Rae (Docs): Final checklist before merge: 1) swap snippets (done) 2) add migration shim (done) 3) add known-issue + rollback link (done) 4) i18n keys queued (i18n-bot) 5) docs-ci green.
Priya (PM): All set from PM. Publish on deploy and notify marketing with the one-liner.
Rae (Docs): Merging now. Will post the staging URL once live and drop the marketing sentence. Thanks team.
Ken (SDK): Quick FYI — I added a note in the Go snippet about the new constructor option WithAPIHost("api.redwood.ai"). Saves a support ticket later.
Marta (QA): Monitoring staging traces for errors; will report if any spike.
Rae (Docs): Nice. If anything pops after merge, rollback instructions are in the runbook. Otherwise, congrats and thanks. :tada:
